title: The Ground Spirit Pill
summary: Yao Lao refines the Sixth-Tier Ground Spirit Pill in the mountains with the Black Demon Cauldron while Xiao Yan watches. Meanwhile, Mr. Ling tells Xun Er that her clan will come to take her home in a month and that the elders think Xiao Yan doesn't deserve her. The pill's forming causes a sky phenomenon that draws Han Feng, the Medicine Emperor of the Black-Corner Region, though he turns back. The First Elder also comes looking, and Xiao Yan hides. Zi Yan then finds him, fakes the elder's voice, and drags him back to the Rock Gate to refine more pills. She reveals she told Han Yue about the Core Quenching Body Milk and makes a herb-hunting deal with him. At the end, Xiao Yu calls him to the Outer Academy, where his second brother Xiao Li lies unconscious.
events: Yao Lao refines the Ground Spirit Pill with the Black Demon Cauldron, herb by herb.
Mr. Ling tells Xun Er the clan will fetch her in a month.
The pill's phenomenon draws Han Feng, who decides not to interfere.
The First Elder searches for the alchemist; Xiao Yan hides.
Zi Yan fakes the elder's voice and takes Xiao Yan back to the Rock Gate.
Zi Yan says she told the gray-haired Han Yue about the milk; she and Xiao Yan agree to hunt herbs together.
Lin Yan attacks Xiao Yan for a spar; Zi Yan scares him off.
Xiao Yu summons Xiao Yan; Xiao Li is unconscious.
cultivation: Han Feng: 'Han Feng isn't just a strongest Dou Huang. He is also a Sixth-Tier Alchemist.'
